excerpts.content:
Thinking about it while listening at ACDC talking about partial cells (⁨`getBlobsV3`⁩).
A stateless node (if no EL - gossiping blobs - running) won't benefit of ⁨`engine_getBlobsVx`⁩ API, and DA will have to rely only on sidecars gossiped via the CL P2P network.
